reviewed_by: Claude review of diagnostics and completions
reason: Five platform findings in the diagnostics and language tooling. (5) The /code/completions route called complete_code synchronously on the event loop with no timeout, and code_completion.py handed the client-supplied path to jedi.Script with the default Project, so Jedi walked the host filesystem for a project root and resolved imports against Core's own sys.path; completions now run under the language server's virtual root and isolated Project, on the bounded analysis pool with the 4 s timeout mapped to an empty item list. (6) Every ERROR record() waited up to 10 s for the writer thread's append+fsync, including the HTTP middleware on every 5xx and record_caught_exception in async code, so a slow disk or error burst stalled the loop; ERROR records issued on a running event loop now return once queued (the never-dropped queue and the writer's own sink handling are unchanged), CRITICAL and synchronous callers still wait, and recent_errors()/export() drain the queue with a bounded flush so readers keep read-your-writes. (7) _memory_errors had no maxlen and the sensitive-detail memory fallback had no byte cap; the deque is now bounded by MAX_MEMORY_ERRORS and the memory store evicts oldest-first past MAX_SENSITIVE_MEMORY_BYTES, and a record whose aggregate append failed is no longer retained twice. (11) operator_detail copied str(exception) for nebula.* exceptions verbatim, exporting '[Errno N]' text and absolute host paths; those are now scrubbed at record build time while the message itself is kept. (12) Timed-out Jedi/Ruff analyses kept running on the loop's default executor and could exhaust it; analyses now run on a dedicated bounded ThreadPoolExecutor and a session drops queued work for document versions it has already replaced (LSP -32801 for requests). test_code_completion (new, 2 tests), four new tests in test_diagnostics, one in test_diagnostic_sensitive and one in test_language_server each fail on main for the stated defect; test_diagnostics_api gains flushes before its direct file reads and, with test_diagnostic_guidance, test_language_server_diagnostics and test_api, guards the touched record/export/route paths.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through api.py) does not exercise editor completions, the diagnostics writer acknowledgement, the sensitive-detail memory fallback or the language-server analysis pool; the Python tests drive them directly. No full suites.
